data.title: Zane Gonzalez brought in by Dolphins
data.summary: Zane Gonzalez signed with the Dolphins on Tuesday.
data.impact: After trying out multiple kickers, Gonzalez was signed by the Dolphins to begin the week. Riley Patterson was released soon after.

data.title: Riley Patterson released by Dolphins
data.summary: Riley Patterson was released by the Dolphins on Tuesday.
data.impact: The Dolphins will make a mid-season change at kicker. Veteran Zane Gonzalez was signed on Tuesday after the team tried out multiple kickers.
